component: Ord. 2526-2025 (§3332.355): ADUs (internal, attached or detached) by right in all residential and apartment residential districts; one per lot with a single-unit dwelling (R-2F: also with a two-unit dwelling; R-4: two per lot up to 5 units)

coverage: Citywide, all residential (Chapter 3332) and apartment residential (Chapter 3333) districts; certificates of appropriateness still required in historic and architectural review areas
coding_notes: Approved as amended by Council 2025-11-24, signed by the mayor 2025-11-25 (Legistar history); fact sheet: '30-Day standard effective date', so effective_date = 2025-11-25 + 30 days (computed). Before this, ADUs needed a Council variance (110 approved, 57 permits 2019-Sep 2025 per the ordinance's explanation). Size: 65% of the principal dwelling's floor area or 1,000 sq ft, whichever is greater, never larger than the principal dwelling: adu_max_sqft=1000 is the floor of that cap. Height: principal dwelling or 25 ft. Exempt from lot-width and area-district requirements; lot coverage up to 65%. adus_per_lot=1 (R-4: 2); unit_cap=2 is principal + ADU on a single-unit lot. No owner-occupancy rule in §3332.355. lot_split=False: the ADU must stay on the principal dwelling's lot. Text read from Exhibit A as attached in Legistar; whether the 2025-11-24 Council amendment changed it was not checked. Second coder (2026-10-18): confirmed; the 2025-11-24 Council amendment made no text change.
